source("../../00-constants.R")






# 3.1. Export protein matrix


write.csv(
  protein_mat,
  file.path(prot_data_dir,"protein_mat.csv"),
  row.names=T
)






# 3.2. Define Workflow Parameters


# Define parameters
Definite <- table(metadata_df$LRTI_adjudication)["Definite"]
No_Evidence <- table(metadata_df$LRTI_adjudication)["No Evidence"]
npatients <- nrow(metadata_df)
nproteins <- ncol(protein_mat)

# Store parameters as data frame
Parameters <- data.frame(
  Count = c(
    npatients,
    Definite,
    No_Evidence,
    nproteins,
    nfolds,
    ntrees
  )
)

rownames(Parameters) <- c(
  "Patients",
  "Definite",
  "No Evidence",
  "Proteins",
  "Folds",
  "RF Trees"
)
